name: Bairlasshof
beschreibung: The Bairlasshof is a traditional inn located in Tyrol, offering comfortable accommodation and authentic dining. Embodying the classic charm of an Alpine gasthof, it combines restful lodging with hearty regional cuisine. Guests can savour delicious local Tyrolean specialities in a warm, welcoming setting. The inn is an ideal base for travellers seeking straightforward lodging infused with genuine Tyrolean hospitality.
